items.title: EAN 2026: New Fintepla data in Dravet Syndrome and LGS
items.summary: The trial of Fintepla in Dravet Syndrome and LGS was run by researchers at the Brno Epilepsy Centre in Czechia.

items.title: Lilly and Regeneron amongst first incumbents to FDA’s fast-track facility scheme
items.summary: Seven pharma companies have been selected for the FDA PreCheck pilot – a framework intended to bolster the US drug supply chain.

items.title: Talawar Therapeutics to debut on Nasdaq with $285m as Dupixent challenger
items.summary: Talawar Therapeutics will use the funds to take its AD (eczema) bispecific, TALA-125, through to Phase IIb proof-of-concept trials.

items.title: Anixa Biosciences secures Korean patent for breast cancer vaccine
items.summary: Anixa Biosciences has secured patent from the Korean Ministry of Intellectual Property (MOIP) for its breast cancer vaccine technology.

items.title: Three years on: How is the industry coping with Annex 1?
items.summary: Industry expert Ian Hudson shares his insights into the deeper nuances and practical impact of the revised EU GMP Annex 1.
